a2-unit-11.11.1 Surprise party:
Kate: Is Tom at school?
Lucy: Yes, he's been at school since eight. He doesn't suspect anything! I've never organized a surprise party before. Have you?
Kate: Yes, I have. I've made a list of everything we need to do. Have you bought his present yet?
Lucy: Yes, I have. I bought him a new pair of running shoes last weekend. His old ones are terrible!
Kate: Perfect. And I invited the guests two weeks ago. Megan can't come, but she's already sent a card from Seattle.
Lucy: That's so nice. We've already ordered the pizzas, right?
Kate: Right, but they haven't arrived yet. The delivery is at six thirty.
Lucy: Have you made the cake yet?
Kate: No, I still haven't made it. Can you believe it? I make cakes every day for my customers, but I haven't had time for my own brother!
Lucy: Ha! What kind of cake does he like?
Kate: Carrot cake with chocolate frosting. It's a Brazilian recipe. Ana sent it to me.
Lucy: Yum! And is the bakery ready for the party?
Kate: Almost. I've just cleaned the tables and moved the chairs. Look!
Lucy: It looks great! When are we going to blow up the balloons?
Kate: Oh no! I've forgotten to buy the balloons!
Lucy: Don't worry. I'll go to the store and get some now. My arm is fine. I can carry them!
Kate: Thanks! I'll start the cake.
